required_changes: numbers.how_to_check (and body item 3, exemplar line): status bar items can be switched off or absent by default on some platforms (Excel for Mac, Excel for the web, customised Windows bars), so a missing Sum should not be read as 'stored as text'. Proposed: 'Select C2:C9. Look at the status bar at the bottom of the window: it should show Sum: 440 (and Count: 8 if Count is shown). If you do not see them, right-click the status bar and tick Sum and Count. If Sum is smaller than 440 or missing, some amounts were stored as text (they usually sit at the left of the cell): retype them as plain numbers.'

range.how_to_check, practice answer, body item 5: F2 may not work on Mac laptops without the Fn key (or Ctrl+U on Mac). Proposed: 'Click C10 and double-click the cell (or press F2; on a Mac you may need Fn+F2 or Control+U). Excel outlines the cells the formula uses in colour: the outline should start at C2 and end at C9. Press Esc to leave the cell unchanged.' Practice answer: 'press F2 (Fn+F2 or Control+U on some Macs) or double-click the cell'.
